# Design system project instructions

Read `AGENTS.md`, then `CLAUDE.md`. They route every model and harness to the same canonical rules. For NPVE work, use the validated `workflow/npve-contract.generated.json`, including its execution policy; do not routinely load the full aggregate.

`workflow/execution-policy.md` covers buildable plans, visible milestones, bounded recovery and plain-language communication with the UX designer. Read it if the contract has not already supplied it. Planning and execution can remain in this session. This file is a routing pointer, not a separate rule set.
